purpose: Add a second source-traceable Fanny Crosby hymn with public-domain lyrics, CC0 playable notation, and presentation-ready text.
guardrails: Lyrics were transcribed line by line from the cited public-domain hymnal record without modernization.
Hymnary identifies both Fanny Crosby's text and William H. Doane's tune as public domain.
The MIDI setting is retained from the exact Wikimedia Commons file page under its CC0 dedication.
The MIDI and machine-readable Wikimedia license metadata are verified by SHA-256.
No historical or modern performance recording is included or implied to be reusable.

entries.title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior
entries.presentation_use: Four stanza slides with the public-domain refrain and a title slide linked to KJV Scripture references.
entries.recording_scope: The in-app Web Audio playback is synthesized from the retained CC0 MIDI. No third-party performance recording is copied.
